Under the income method GDP (domestic product) is the sum of factor incomes earned within the domestic territory (wages, rent, interest, profit, mixed income), with depreciation added for the gross figure; adding NFIA gives a national, not domestic, aggregate. Transfer payments are never part of factor incomes, so 'minus transfer payments' is not a step of the method.
source: NextGen Indian Economy - APPSC 12 p.3-5; Ramesh Singh Indian Economy 10th ed. part 03 p.47
evidence: NCERT Class 12 Macroeconomics ch.2 (income method: GDP = W + P + In + R)
